newsitem.title: USA: California robbers rip-off ATM -- from the wall.
newsitem.headline: California robbers rip-off ATM -- from the wall.

text.p: Two robbers ripped off an automated teller machine, literally, at a California bowling alley. They tore the ATM from the wall and carted it away, police said on Tuesday.

Lt. Ed Tunstall, of the police force in Orange, some 40 miles (70 km) south of Los Angeles, said the two robbers backed their truck up to the Regal Lanes Bowling Centre early on Monday morning and pried open the double glass doors.
They held a janitor at gunpoint and made him lie on the floor as they used tools to rip a 400-pound (181 kilogram) cash dispensing machine off the wall of the bowling alley.
They then carried the California United Bank ATM outside, loaded it on their truck and sped off, Tunstall said.
A spokesman for the California Banker's Association said the robbers had done the easiest part. Now they had to open the ATM.
But Tunstall said that after all the effort to steal it, he was sure the robbers would find a way to empty it of cash.
He would not say, however, how much it contained.
